reviews.comment: He isn't the best lecturer and a bit hard to understand due to his accent. However, his tests aren't very difficult and the information isn't too hard. If you go to class and pay attention, it isn't that hard. Not a good question answerer. Easy homeworks. Lab isn't overly difficult, just filling out questions for a lab report.

Seems like a nice guy, but he's impossible to understand. Questions on test's are definitely 'reach' questions and there are never any straightforward questions. I studied for 2 hours a day for 2 weeks for the last exam and only got an 80. The only good thing is that tests are MC rather than the usual free response used by other 213 professors.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice prof, very understanding. He let people move their tests if they had the MCAT which was very kind. Don't underestimate the lab for this class though!! Some of the TA's are strict. He curved generously.

Super cool professor, although his lectures are quite boring. Makes his questions extremely clear for students in class on exams and is available to ask questions. Just make a quizlet over the information and you will be fine. English is a late-second language for him so don't be afraid to clarify questions and ask multiple times.

Took him for BIOL 388 (not BIOL 213), and he was great! His lectures could be a bit boring, but he's very clear when explaining topics. He cares about his students and is always very nice when you ask him questions :-)

He is a very nice professor and made 213 pretty easy. The class itself is only graded on tests but it is all based off the slides and he makes sure to point out the key points you need to know. Very willing to go over test questions with you and will even give back points if he feels there could be more than one correct answer. Definitely recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is literally the nicest professor and made 213 the best class to be in. He could be difficult to understand at times, but he is so willing to help that it made it all worth it. He had a "must know" note for the slides he was testing over and knowing those made you well-prepped for the class.
